d: Bolivud abhinetri mahima chaudhri ne bite varshon men bihar men hue sakaratmak badlavon, patna sthit bihar myujiyam ko eshiya ka nanbar-1 myujiyam ghoshit kie jane aur is pariyojna men purv mukhyamantri nitish kumar ke yogdan ko lekar apni pratikriya di hai. midiya se batchit ke dauran mahima chaudhri ne bihar ki pragti aur rajy men barhte rojgar va shiksha ke avasron ki sarahna ki.
